description: Reports the credit balance, tier, rate limits, and upgrade options for the API key on this connection, or the free-tier allowance and the key URL for an anonymous caller. Free — this call does not consume a credit. Also mints or returns a referral code; `referral_code` on later calls keeps the same referral identity.

referral_code.description: An active referral code returned by an earlier account.status call. Pass it back to keep the same referral identity; if it is no longer active, account.status issues a new code instead.

name: account.status

isError.description: True when the tool could not complete successfully.

text.description: Human-readable tool result (also mirrored in content[].text).

title: Check account status
